_readme: SAIRNlaw deadline engine seed -- South Dakota (SDCL ch. 15-6 and 15-26A-6).
Gate: docs/sairnlaw-southdakota-deadline-seed-gate.md (hank b64, 2026-10-29). Every value read verbatim from
sdlegislature.gov on 2026-10-29 and quoted in its row. Every open reading resolves EARLY.

authority.quote: A defendant shall serve the answer within thirty days after the service of the complaint upon defendant, except when otherwise provided by statute or rule.
authority.note: NO service_extension: service of the complaint is process, not "a notice or other paper" between parties (EARLY). effective_from is the last amendment of SDCL 15-6-6(a) (Sup. Ct. Rule 18-14, eff. 2018-07-01); this section's own history was not traced for earlier matters.

authority.quote: A party served with a pleading stating a cross-claim shall serve an answer within twenty days after the service.
authority.note: Paper served between parties: 15-6-6(e) reaches it. effective_from is the last amendment of SDCL 15-6-6(a) (Sup. Ct. Rule 18-14, eff. 2018-07-01); this section's own history was not traced for earlier matters.

service_extension.note: SDCL 15-6-6(e): "the notice or paper is served by mail, three days shall be added to the prescribed period. Service by facsimile or electronic mail transmission shall not be deemed service by mail." Base count is 20 or more, so the unstated under-11 ordering question cannot arise on this row.

authority.quote: The plaintiff shall serve a reply to a counterclaim in the answer within twenty days after service of the answer
authority.note: The court-ordered-reply limb is not seeded. effective_from is the last amendment of SDCL 15-6-6(a) (Sup. Ct. Rule 18-14, eff. 2018-07-01); this section's own history was not traced for earlier matters.

service_extension.note: SDCL 15-6-6(e): "the notice or paper is served by mail, three days shall be added to the prescribed period. Service by facsimile or electronic mail transmission shall not be deemed service by mail." Base count is 20 or more, so the unstated under-11 ordering question cannot arise on this row.

rules.label: Answers and objections to interrogatories (South Dakota)

authority.quote: The party upon whom the interrogatories have been served shall serve a copy of the answers, and objections, if any, within thirty days after the service of the interrogatories, except that a defendant may serve answers or objections within forty-five days after service of the summons and complaint upon that defendant.
authority.note: THE 30-DAY LIMB; the defendant's 45-day floor is not computed (EARLY). effective_from is the last amendment of SDCL 15-6-6(a) (Sup. Ct. Rule 18-14, eff. 2018-07-01); this section's own history was not traced for earlier matters.

service_extension.note: SDCL 15-6-6(e): "the notice or paper is served by mail, three days shall be added to the prescribed period. Service by facsimile or electronic mail transmission shall not be deemed service by mail." Base count is 20 or more, so the unstated under-11 ordering question cannot arise on this row.

rules.label: Response to a request for production (South Dakota)

authority.quote: The party upon whom the request is served shall serve a written response within thirty days after the service of the request, except that a defendant may serve a response within forty - five days after service of the summons and complaint upon that defendant.
authority.note: THE 30-DAY LIMB; the 45-day defendant floor is not computed (EARLY). effective_from is the last amendment of SDCL 15-6-6(a) (Sup. Ct. Rule 18-14, eff. 2018-07-01); this section's own history was not traced for earlier matters.

service_extension.note: SDCL 15-6-6(e): "the notice or paper is served by mail, three days shall be added to the prescribed period. Service by facsimile or electronic mail transmission shall not be deemed service by mail." Base count is 20 or more, so the unstated under-11 ordering question cannot arise on this row.

rules.label: Response to a request for admission (South Dakota)

authority.quote: The matter is admitted unless, within thirty days after service of the request, or within such shorter or longer time as the court may allow or as the parties may agree to in writing, the party to whom the request is directed serves upon the party requesting the admission a written answer or objection
authority.note: A missed date ADMITS the matter. The 45-day defendant floor is not computed (EARLY). effective_from is the last amendment of SDCL 15-6-6(a) (Sup. Ct. Rule 18-14, eff. 2018-07-01); this section's own history was not traced for earlier matters.

service_extension.note: SDCL 15-6-6(e): "the notice or paper is served by mail, three days shall be added to the prescribed period. Service by facsimile or electronic mail transmission shall not be deemed service by mail." Base count is 20 or more, so the unstated under-11 ordering question cannot arise on this row.

rules.label: Motion for a new trial (South Dakota)

authority.quote: The motion for a new trial stating the grounds thereof shall be served and filed not later than ten days after the notice of entry of the judgment.
authority.note: TEN IS UNDER ELEVEN, so intermediate Saturdays, Sundays and legal holidays are excluded. NO service_extension, by the EARLY reading shared with AK and ND (a mailed notice of entry may earn 15-6-6(e) days; in the lawyer's question). effective_from is the last amendment of SDCL 15-6-6(a) (Sup. Ct. Rule 18-14, eff. 2018-07-01); this section's own history was not traced for earlier matters.

authority.quote: An appeal from a judgment or order must be taken within thirty days after the judgment or order shall be signed, attested, filed and written notice of entry thereof shall have been given to the adverse party.
authority.note: Computed under 15-6-6(a), which governs "any applicable statute". NO service_extension, by the EARLY reading; the 15-6-59 / 15-6-50(b) tolling sentence is not modelled. effective_from is the last amendment of SDCL 15-6-6(a) (Sup. Ct. Rule 18-14, eff. 2018-07-01); this section's own history was not traced for earlier matters.
